name: Ultralight Walnut Slats, Grey Felt
summary: Real walnut veneer laminated onto 9 mm recycled acoustic felt, with a grey felt backing and no MDF or rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec dimensions override photo estimates: seven 30.5 mm walnut faces on 42.8 mm pitches with 12.3 mm, 90-degree V-grooves about 6.2 mm deep in 9 mm felt, with no rigid core; the seven-pitch tile is 299.6 mm wide versus the rounded nominal 300 mm panel. Muted walnut tone is sampled from the main listing photo, with light grey felt matched to that photo; procedural grain wraps over the 599.2 mm tile height.
